review_description: Craig arranged for our 8.2kW Fronius inverter system 3 years ago while house was  being built. He installed the wiring when the house was at frame stage and happy to wait until completion to install panels and inverter. Hence, we have a super neat install on our 2 storey home with no external conduit. System has been great, one small hiccup with inverter just before Christmas, sorted promptly. Glad to have bulk of our electrical needs (ducted AC, spa heat pump) powered by sun.

Craig and his team were not the run of the mill contractors.They were always courteous,  on time and very informative throughout the whole process.  He is well knowledged in the solar game and did everything to get maximum power from the unit.Panels and inverter are of superior quality and have definitely helped reduce our power bill.I would definitely recommend Coastal solar.

From start to finish, everything was professional and punctual as promised. After sales is also top notch. It's still early days but the savings look promising. Thank you Steve and Jackson..... and thank you Solar Quotes.
